title: Technology Sector Update for 08/21/2018: NOK, UTX, GSB - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.3%
AAPL: +0.4%
IBM: flat
CSCO: +0.2%
GOOG: +0.3%
Technology shares were higher in pre-market trade on Tuesday.
Expected movers:
- Nokia ( NOK ): expects 'significant position' in Standard Essential Patents, licensing rate for 5G SEP portfolio capped at 3 euros per device
- United Technologies ( UTX ): acquires predictive analytics software maker Predikto
- GlobalSCAPE ( GSB ): plans $15 million modified Dutch auction tender offer at up to 29.7% premium
